svg.title: Life of a request through Kong on AWS
svg.desc: Numbered path: 1 client or agent calls the kong-dp domain; 2 Amazon Route 53 resolves to the Network Load Balancer; 3 the NLB terminates TLS with the ACM certificate; 4 the Kong data plane pod on Amazon EKS matches the route and runs plugins; 5 Kong gets AWS credentials from its EKS Pod Identity IAM role; 6 Bedrock AgentCore runs the agent, or Amazon Bedrock runs the model; 7 the response returns the same way. Kong Konnect sends configuration and receives analytics; AgentCore writes logs to Amazon CloudWatch.
svg.text: Life of a request (the A2A call from Step 3)
The response travels back through Kong and the NLB to the caller
Policies that can run at step 4: key auth or OpenID Connect (Kong Identity, Step 5), AI rate limiting by tokens or cost,
AI AWS Guardrails, AI A2A / MCP proxy, OpenTelemetry export. This guide configures the AI A2A Proxy; the others are listed for context.
Solid arrows: request traffic. Dashed arrows: management or telemetry, never prompts or responses.
